title: No need to wait when the quota is used up! ChatGPT Plus quietly launches an $8 reset button
excerpt: According to feedback from Reddit users, OpenAI is currently quietly testing a new paid feature in a limited release: after ChatGPT Plus users exhaust their wee
content_html:
According to feedback from Reddit users, OpenAI is currently quietly testing a new paid feature in a limited release: after ChatGPT Plus users exhaust their weekly usage quota, the interface will display an option to "Pay $8 to reset immediately." An OpenAI spokesperson later confirmed that the company is exploring ways to allow over-quota users to purchase additional quotas, aiming to improve product usability.

Previously, OpenAI had introduced a cumulative reset mechanism for Codex in June this year. The new "full reset" feature skips the approximately 5-hour recovery waiting period, instantly restoring the usage quota to 100%, and extending the next weekly reset by 7 days. For frequent professional users who previously spent between $25 to $50 per week, this solution significantly reduces the cost of computing power supplementation.

This move is an extension of OpenAI's recent user expansion strategies. As competition with major rival Anthropic intensifies in the AI programming tools sector (Codex vs. Claude Code), both companies are frequently using free quota resets, subscription service gifts, and expanded usage limits to attract developers. By lowering the usage barrier and cultivating user habits, AI giants aim to drive critical workflows into their ecosystems, thereby locking in long-term commercial monetization opportunities.

content_html_zh:
根据 Reddit 用户的反馈，OpenAI 目前正在限量版中悄悄测试一项新的付费功能：ChatGPT Plus 用户用完每周的使用配额后，界面会显示“支付 8 美元立即重置”的选项。 OpenAI发言人随后证实，该公司正在探索允许超配额用户购买额外配额的方式，旨在提高产品可用性。

此前，OpenAI已于今年6月为Codex引入了累积重置机制。 新的“完全重置”功能跳过了大约5小时的恢复等待期，立即将使用配额恢复到100%，并将下一次每周重置延长7天。 对于以前每周花费在 25 至 50 美元之间的频繁专业用户来说，该解决方案显着降低了算力补充成本。

此举是OpenAI近期用户扩张策略的延伸。 随着人工智能编程工具领域与主要竞争对手 Anthropic 的竞争加剧（Codex vs. Claude Code），两家公司都频繁使用免费配额重置、订阅服务赠品和扩大使用限制来吸引开发者。 通过降低使用门槛和培养用户习惯，人工智能巨头旨在将关键工作流程引入其生态系统，从而锁定长期商业变现机会。
